characters.name: OldGrower
characters.role: Veteran Growtopia player — the comeback legend; rags-to-riches-to-scam-to-riches arc

young.description: Newbie player, basic white t-shirt and blue pants, no accessories, eager hopeful expression, fresh start
young.appearance: Growtopia pixel-art character: blocky 2D pixel humanoid, chibi proportions with large head and small body, simple dot eyes and small mouth, basic white t-shirt and blue pants, no accessories, clean pixel edges, retro 16-bit game sprite aesthetic, eager hopeful expression, slim build

mature.description: Veteran player, golden crown, white angel wings, Rayman Fist weapon, royal purple outfit with gold trim, confident wise stance
mature.appearance: Growtopia pixel-art character: blocky 2D pixel humanoid, chibi proportions with large head and small body, simple dot eyes and small mouth, golden crown on head, white angel wings spread on back, holding Rayman fist weapon in right hand, royal purple outfit with gold trim and pixel detail stitching, confident wise expression, broader stance, clean pixel edges, retro 16-bit game sprite aesthetic

characters.voice_style: Nostalgic male narrator, warm and reflective, slight rasp of experience, speaks with reverence for the old days. Starts heavy and broken in hook, builds warmth during origin, sharpens with pride during empire-building, drops to devastation during scam, rebuilds quiet determination, finishes with earned confidence.

story_arc.hook: I lost everything in Growtopia. My world, my items, my reputation. But that's not how my story ends.
story_arc.origin: Started as a noob with nothing. First day, someone gave me a World Lock. Changed my life forever.
story_arc.turning_point: Built an empire. Thousands of worlds. Then the great scam took it all — Crown, Wings, Locks, years of work, gone.
story_arc.revelation: Came back with nothing but knowledge. Built it all again. Now richer than ever. The real treasure in Growtopia is knowledge.

environments_used: Beginner world with basic blocks and a single small tree
Bustling trade world with vending machines and display boxes
Empty devastated world with broken blocks and cracked ground
Grand rebuilt world with pixel-art castle, fountains, and Diamond Lock display cases

characters.name: Stormcaller
characters.role: an original Growtopia player character built from the Zeus set — a nobody farmer struck by legendary lightning who ascends, lets power go to his head, nearly loses it in a storm backlash, and ends up sharing it as a mentor to newcomers

costume_stages.mortal: 2D pixel-art Growtopian, blocky humanoid, tan/beige blocky skin (~#C9A67C), large square head, two white dot eyes with black pupils, small flat mouth, thick clean black outline, plain brown work shirt, patched grey trousers, dirt-stained tiny blocky hands, no hat, no cosmetic set, humble slim build, holding a wooden hoe, eager but weary expression

characters.voice_style: Male narrator, mythic and self-aware. Starts wry and a little shaken (post-crisis hook), warms into plain humility during origin, swells with cocky pride during the Zeus ascension and hubris beats, cracks with alarm during the storm backlash, settles into a warm grounded mentor tone for the revelation.

story_arc.hook: I'm Stormcaller — the Growtopian chosen by Zeus's own lightning. I nearly lost everything it gave me.
story_arc.origin: Before the storm, I was nobody. Just a farmer breaking blocks for gems, world after world.
story_arc.turning_point: Lightning found me and the Zeus set became mine. Power went to my head — I flaunted my crown and mocked players who had nothing. Then the storm turned on me and nearly tore the crown from my hands.
story_arc.revelation: Now I share the storm instead of hoarding it. Every newbie I meet gets a spark of it.

characters.name: Seraph
characters.role: an original Growtopia player character built from the Angelic set — a trader scammed out of everything who earns the Angelic set by choosing to help a stranger instead of despairing, becoming a guardian who protects newcomers from scammers

costume_stages.unmarked: 2D pixel-art Growtopian, blocky humanoid, tan/beige blocky skin (~#C9A67C), large square head, two white dot eyes with black pupils, small flat mouth, thick clean black outline, bright cyan/turquoise short-sleeve t-shirt (~#3FC1D6), medium-blue pants (~#5B6DC8), tiny blocky hands, no hat, no cosmetic set, open trusting expression

characters.voice_style: Male narrator, warm and steady with a current of quiet hurt underneath. Starts serene and knowing in the hook, turns open and naive during origin, cracks with disbelief through the scam, softens into trembling resolve at the moment of giving, settles into a calm protective guardian-mentor tone for the revelation.

story_arc.hook: I'm Seraph — once Growtopia's easiest mark, now its self-appointed Guardian of every newcomer.
story_arc.origin: Back then I was just a trader, trusting and open.
story_arc.turning_point: A smooth-talking conman promised riches and took everything I had. Broke and alone, I gave my last coin away to someone even poorer than me — and that selfless act triggered the Angelic transformation.
story_arc.revelation: Now I walk the plazas as a guardian, so no newbie ever loses what I lost.

characters.name: Dragonkin
characters.role: an original Growtopia player character built from the Dragon set (Baby Dragon) — a bonding/patience story about raising a baby dragon from a cracked egg into a fully bonded partner, told through three costume stages instead of a power arc

costume_stages.unbonded: plain worn brown work vest and patched grey trousers, no dragon features, cradling a fist-sized cracked orb-egg with faint warm cracks of orange light
costume_stages.half-bonded: same base body with one small patchy green scale-patch sprouting unevenly on the scalp, a short stub tail poking from the waistband, no wings yet, a thin sputtering flame flickering at the mouth corner, uncertain wide-eyed expression
costume_stages.fully-bonded: complete Dragon set (verbatim game canon): green scaled dragon hood and tail, small folded wings, tiny pixel flame breath from mouth, spiky scaled details, fierce playful side-view pose

characters.voice_style: Young adult narrator, gentle and patient rather than boastful. Hook opens warm and a little wondrous. Origin is plain and humble. The storm turning-point cracks with worry but never panics — delivery slows and softens rather than escalating, to sell 'patience over force'. Revelation settles into quiet, contented warmth.

story_arc.hook: Found a cracked egg no one else wanted in a forgotten mining tunnel.
story_arc.origin: Kept it warm by the campfire, fed it, waited without knowing if it would ever hatch.
story_arc.turning_point: A storm hit while the hatchling was still fragile — panic would have scared it off, so I waited instead, and it chose to trust me.
story_arc.revelation: Now fully bonded, we stand together in the plaza — proof patience raises what force never could.

environments_used: Forgotten mining tunnel of cracked dark stone blocks with one glowing warm orb wedged in rubble
Humble starter world with a small campfire, wooden crate, and a planted torch
Open storm-lashed hilltop world under a jagged lightning-lit sky
Sunrise-lit garden world with fresh tilled soil blocks and a small hay nest
Bright grand plaza world with a tile-block fountain and a Growtopia banner

characters.name: Grinshade
characters.role: an original Growtopia player character built from the Devil/Demonic set — a temptation/corruption story about a scammed player who bargains away his humble start for demonic power and never looks back, an unrepentant villain turn with no redemption

costume_stages.innocent: 2D pixel-art Growtopian, blocky humanoid, tan/beige blocky skin (~#C9A67C), large square head, two white dot eyes with black pupils, small flat mouth, thick clean black outline, patched grey work vest, faded green trousers, worn blocky hands, no hat, no cosmetic set, humble slim build, hopeful uncertain half-smile, holding a cracked wooden mining pick

costume_stages.corrupted: 2D pixel-art Growtopian in Demonic set, dark red skin, black bat wings, curved horns, glowing red eyes, mischievous sharp-toothed grin, dark smoky aura, tiny clawed blocky hands, large square head, thick clean black outline, menacing side-view stance

characters.voice_style: Male narrator, sly and seductive with dark charisma. story_arc.hook: I am Grinshade — and I'd make the devil's bargain again in a heartbeat.
story_arc.origin: I started with nothing. Every trade I made got robbed.
story_arc.turning_point: A shadow merchant offered me power instead of pity. The horns grew first, then the wings, then I stopped caring what I used to be.
story_arc.revelation: They call it a curse. I call it the best deal I ever made.

characters.name: Master Peng
characters.role: Growtopia's martial-arts grandmaster NPC (wiki: Master Peng) — an elderly Iron Fist master who trained alone before founding his hillside dojo, humbled by defeat, rebuilt on patience instead of pure strength

costume_stages.default: 2D pixel-art Growtopian elder martial-arts grandmaster, tan/beige blocky skin, large square head, one subtly narrowed eye, stern flat mouth, long white pixel beard, bald crown with grey topknot, red-and-gold gi crossed with a black sash, faded wrist/knuckle wraps, straw sandals, a bamboo training staff taller than himself, calloused tiny hands, upright disciplined posture, thick clean black outline

characters.voice_style: Elderly wise martial-arts grandmaster — deep, measured, gravelly timbre; unhurried, deliberate cadence. Serene/knowing hook, humble reflective origin, quiet shame at the ring defeat, thoughtful resolve rebuilding, warm authoritative teaching register for the revelation. MiniMax voice_id used: Deep_Voice_Man.

story_arc.hook: I am Master Peng, grandmaster of the Iron Fist and keeper of this hillside dojo.
story_arc.origin: Before the dojo existed, I trained here completely alone — one staff, one dummy, no students.
story_arc.turning_point: I fought on pure strength, until a boy half my size shattered my staff in a single move. Kneeling in that dirt taught me more humility than any victory ever had.
story_arc.revelation: So I rebuilt my style on patience, and rebuilt this dojo one student at a time. Now every fist that trains here learns stillness long before it ever learns to strike.

characters.age_progression: None — no canonical age variants; single mature appearance throughout, story progression carried by environment/props (unfinished platform to thriving dojo; whole staff to shattered to rebound staff).

characters.voice_style: Synthetic-tinged but earnest young-machine register — plainspoken/matter-of-fact in workshop beats, light distortion/alarm during the storm malfunction, warm and proud for the revelation. MiniMax voice_id used: Casual_Guy.

story_arc.hook: I am Robert, The Robot — built to guard every World Lock in Growtopia.
story_arc.origin: Before I was Robert, I was scrap — mismatched bolts and wire on a workshop bench. Then my creator threw the switch, and my eye flickered awake for the first time.
story_arc.turning_point: A storm hit the vault — sparks tore through my circuits and I nearly shut down.
story_arc.revelation: My creator rebuilt me stronger, plated me in polished steel, and gave me real purpose. Now I stand watch over every locked vault in Growtopia — and I never sleep.

characters.age_progression: Built-not-born equivalent: prototype (rough first assembly) vs. finished (rebuilt/polished) — both visualized across the arc, counts as the age-progression requirement for a machine character.

characters.role: Growtopia's circus impresario NPC (wiki: The Ringmaster) — a nobody juggler who built his own stage and crossed a wire over a lava pit to earn the crowd

characters.voice_style: Male showman narrator, theatrical carnival-barker energy with real vulnerability underneath — controlled bravado at the hook, wearier confiding origin, gritted-then-explosive turning point, booming warm revelation. MiniMax voice_id used: Deep_Voice_Man.

story_arc.hook: I am the Ringmaster, master of ceremonies of Growtopia's Grand Circus, and the crowd's last hope tonight.
story_arc.origin: Before the applause, I was a nobody juggler, tossed off every corner stage in Growtopia. No one clapped, so I built my own stage — a tent stitched from scraps and dares.
story_arc.turning_point: I strung a wire across a pit of lava and bet my life on one impossible walk. The wire held. The flames roared beneath me.
story_arc.revelation: And Growtopia finally learned my name. Now I run the greatest show under any tent — because the show must always go on.

characters.age_progression: None — no canonical age/costume variants; single regalia throughout, rise-and-reveal arc delivered via staging (empty practice tent to packed spotlight center ring) instead of costume change.

story_arc.hook: I'm Locke the Salesman — Growtopia's wandering trader, and not every deal I've made was clean.
story_arc.origin: I started with an empty cart and a busted wheel, hawking scraps nobody wanted. Fast talk turns junk into gold — soon my cart rattled with locks from every world.
story_arc.turning_point: Then I sold a rigged lucky lock to a kid with nothing left. Watching him walk away broke made my own tricks taste like ash in my mouth.
story_arc.revelation: Now every lock I sell holds true — Locke's word never breaks.

characters.age_progression: None — no canonical age variants; cart/prop state (battered/empty to full-and-thriving to guarantee-stamped) carries the transformation instead.

characters.voice_style: Mature adult male, steady low register, dutiful and reserved — firm/clipped hook, plain wistful origin, quiet shame at the mistake, hardened resolve, gritted siege, calm understated pride for the revelation (no triumphant swell). MiniMax voice_id used: Determined_Man.

story_arc.hook: I'm Geoff, the Guard of the Growtopia Bank vault — no one gets past me.
story_arc.origin: I signed up for the dullest post in Growtopia — nobody else wanted the night shift.
story_arc.turning_point: One night I dozed off, and a thief slipped past me into the vault. I never forgave myself. I swore I'd never leave that gate unwatched again.
story_arc.revelation: Years later, a whole gang tried to break the vault. I held the gate alone. Now every player in Growtopia knows: Geoff's gate has never once fallen since.

episodes.title: The Ringmaster: The Wire Over the Lava Pit
episodes.notes: One of 5 parallel character-story episodes produced in the same run. Scene 5's NB2 generation hit a terminal HTTP 422 on result-fetch (remote reported COMPLETED but no result_url captured) — recovered via one authorized brand-new job (distinct job_id/output_path), not a resubmission of the terminal job. Approved by user.
episodes.lesson: NB2 result-fetch can return a terminal HTTP 422 even after the remote generation reaches COMPLETED, with no result_url ever captured — this is a distinct failure mode from the previously-documented 'FAILED with a recorded result_url' download-failure case. The runner correctly refuses to resubmit the same job_id; recovery requires the Manager to authorize exactly one brand-new job (fresh job_id, same prompt/refs/route) rather than a wrapped retry.
